title: Create a 7z archive
summary: Use the 7z command to compress files or directories into a .7z archive. This format typically offers better compression than zip.

steps.explain: Add the specified file or directory to a new or existing 7z archive.

placeholders.name: ARCHIVE_PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the archive file (e.g., backup.7z)

placeholders.name: FILE_OR_DIR
placeholders.description: Path to the file or directory to compress
